steps.title: Briefing
steps.description: I analyze the project goal, the intended audience and the context (language, platform or market) before I begin.

steps.title: Development
steps.description: I work on the content with a focus on clarity, naturalness and commercial intent, adapting it to the format you need.

steps.title: Review
steps.description: I review consistency, flow and formal details to ensure a polished result that is ready to publish.

steps.title: Delivery
steps.description: I deliver the final content, leaving room for adjustments or observations whenever the project requires them.

whyChooseMe.title: Why choose me for your project?

cards.title: Languages handled with professional judgment
cards.text: I do not translate word for word: I adapt the message so it preserves meaning, tone and credibility in the target language.

cards.title: Results-oriented approach
cards.text: Every text is shaped for its final purpose — to sell, rank or inform — not just to sound good.

cards.title: Commitment in every delivery
cards.text: I meet deadlines, keep communication clear throughout the process and deliver revised content that is ready to publish.
